basic_details.scholarship_name: Kyung Hee University (KHU) President's International Graduate Fellowship & Full Tuition Award
basic_details.offering_entity: Kyung Hee University (KHU) Graduate School & Office of International Affairs
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Kyung Hee University (Seoul and Global Campuses, South Korea)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Engineering, College of Electronics and Information, College of Software, College of Applied Sciences, Graduate School of Biotechnology, College of Life Sciences, and College of Pharmacy.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 140 institutional graduate scholarships awarded per semester
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally; typically 15 to 25 Pakistani STEM and informatics researchers selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 semesters (2 years) for Master's; 6 to 8 semesters (3 to 4 years) for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: KRW 1,200,000 to 1,800,000 / month (~PKR 252,000 to 378,000 / month) provided via host professor's National Research Foundation (NRF) or BK21 Four research grant, combined with 100% full university tuition fee waiver

nationality_requirements: International applicants whose parents both hold non-Korean citizenship (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory maximum age limit, though priority is given to applicants under 35 years of age for graduate research positions.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.20/4.00 for Master's; recognized 18-year Master's degree with minimum CGPA 3.20/4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive candidates typically hold CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00 with laboratory programming or experimental experience.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer engineering, software engineering, artificial intelligence, electrical and electronic engineering, biotechnology, biomedical science, chemical engineering, or related fields.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree requirements before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior publications in IEEE/ACM conferences or SCI/SCIE indexed journals provide a substantial competitive edge.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5, TOEFL iBT minimum 80, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate; TOPIK Level 3+ accepted for Korean-taught majors.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Korean language proficiency is not required for English-track STEM laboratories.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must secure prior contact and an official Research Assistantship Commitment Letter from a Kyung Hee University professor with active BK21 Four grant funding.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full national or institutional fellowship covering identical living and tuition benefits.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver (Scholarship Type A - President's Award) covering entire standard semester duration at Kyung Hee University.

admission_application_fee.details: Online graduate application processing fee of KRW 100,000 paid via UwayApply / JinhakApply system.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate dormitory housing (Woojungwon or Sameuiwon dormitories) at subsidized rates (approx. KRW 250,000 to 380,000 / month), covered easily from stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly research stipend paid through supervisor's research grants (BK21 Four / NRF): KRW 1,200,000 to 1,500,000 / month for Master's; KRW 1,500,000 to 1,800,000 / month for PhD.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Seoul Incheon International Airport is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: South Korean D-2 Student Visa fee paid directly to the Korean Embassy in Islamabad or Gerry's Visa Drop Box.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory enrollment in Korea National Health Insurance Service (NHIS); subsidized student monthly premium (approx. KRW 70,000 / month) paid from monthly stipend.

food_allowance.details: Affordable on-campus cafeterias at Seoul and Global (Suwon) campuses; meals typically cost KRW 4,500 to 6,500.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Kyung Hee Central Library, high-performance computing clusters, clean rooms, and experimental testing facilities supported by research lab.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: International conference registration and travel allowances funded via host laboratory's BK21 Four or national research projects.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free shuttle buses between Kyung Hee Global Campus (Suwon) and Seoul Campus, plus nationwide T-Money transit system integration.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single prestigious Korean comprehensive private university (Kyung Hee University).
participating_institutions: Kyung Hee University (Seoul Campus in Dongdaemun-gu and Global Campus in Yongin/Suwon, South Korea)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #328, Top 40 in Asia; member of Korea's Brain Korea 21 (BK21 Four) initiative and renowned for software, biomedical engineering, and electronic systems.
available_majors: Master's / PhD in Computer Science and Engineering
Master's / PhD in Applied Chemistry and Materials Science
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years; Combined Master's/PhD: 4 to 5 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with CGPA >= 3.20/4.00, academic transcripts, study plan, professor recommendation letter, proof of English (IELTS 6.5+ / TOEFL 80+ / MOI), and supervisor commitment letter.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: High competition in AI, Computer Science, and Electronic Engineering; securing prior commitment from a laboratory PI ensures both admission and full funding.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Review recent publications from Kyung Hee BK21 research groups, email faculty members with a tailored research statement highlighting programming and experimental skills.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Kyung Hee University Graduate School & UwayApply International Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Contact prospective supervisor, secure RA financial support commitment, register on UwayApply, complete application form, upload digital documents, and pay KRW 100,000 fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact prospective Kyung Hee professor in relevant STEM field with CV and research proposal (September for Spring / March for Fall).
Step 2: Attend virtual technical interview and obtain Professor's Confirmation of Research Assistantship & Scholarship Recommendation.
Step 3: Register on UwayApply during the official application window and submit admission dossier.
Step 4: Send notarized hard-copy documents (degrees, transcripts, apostille/attestation) via DHL to KHU Graduate School Office.
Step 5: Departmental admissions committee reviews documents and confirms scholarship category.
Step 6: Receive official Admission Notice and Certificate of Admission (CoA).
Step 7: Apply for South Korean D-2 Student Visa at Korean Embassy in Islamabad.
Step 8: Arrive in South Korea in late February (Spring intake) or late August (Fall intake).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated departmental route: Tuition waiver and laboratory stipend are packaged directly upon faculty recommendation.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted via official letters of recommendation from prior academic professors along with the KHU professor's financial guarantee letter.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan and Personal Statement (prescribed KHU format) outlining motivation, academic achievements, research roadmap, and post-graduation goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research statement detailing proposed laboratory experiments, computational models, and targeted journal deliverables.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic research CV detailing educational history, laboratory proficiencies, software skills, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online video interview via Zoom conducted by prospective research supervisor and laboratory senior researchers.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5+, TOEFL 80+, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA Pakistan attestations required, followed by Korean Embassy consular legalization in Islamabad or Apostille.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Korean translation for all non-English/non-Korean documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via UwayApply followed by mandatory postal dispatch of attested physical dossier to KHU Graduate School.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC, MoFA, and consular legalized by Korean Embassy Islamabad.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed on KHU official application forms detailing background, research interests, and career objectives.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Typed in English using official form.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official letter from Kyung Hee University faculty advisor committing research lab funding and supervision.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained directly from prospective KHU supervisor.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from previous university professors on institutional letterhead.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed and stamped with official university seals.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Bi-annual intake: Spring semester starts in March, Fall semester starts in September.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior CGPA, academic rigor in engineering/science coursework)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Technical research competence, prior publications, supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of purpose and alignment with laboratory goals)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Kyung Hee University Graduate School Admissions Committee, Departmental Faculty Board, and Host Laboratory PI.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: academic review and research potential assessment by laboratory PI followed by graduate school scholarship confirmation.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,500 to 2,000 international applicants across both intakes
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100 to 140 full tuition & stipend awards annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~15.0% to 20.0% for candidates holding pre-secured supervisor RA commitments and CGPA >= 3.40
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate/Master's CGPA >= 3.40 / 4.00, accompanied by strong programming skills or publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: STEM graduates with solid foundations in engineering, mathematics, or computing, clear research focus, and supervisor sponsorship.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani universities (NUST, FAST-NUCES, COMSATS, UET Lahore, Quaid-i-Azam, GIKI).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Vietnam, China, India, Indonesia, Iran, Bangladesh, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply via official portals gskh.khu.ac.kr and uwayapply.com.
Beware of private agents promising guaranteed Korean scholarships; university admission requires direct professor consent.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of KRW 100,000 is paid directly through UwayApply online payment gateway.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agent materials are rejected; candidates must communicate directly with prospective Korean professors.
hidden_costs_breakdown: NADRA FRC and document attestations (HEC, MoFA, Korean Embassy): ~PKR 35,000 to 50,000.
DHL document courier to South Korea: ~PKR 12,000.
Initial living deposit before first stipend payment: ~KRW 500,000 (~PKR 105,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Korean TOPIK certificate is compulsory. Reality: All STEM graduate research is conducted entirely in English.
Myth: Flight tickets are included. Reality: Travel to South Korea is self-funded by student.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs suggest scholarships are automatic without professor contact; without a professor's RA commitment, full funding is virtually impossible.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum semester GPA of 3.50 out of 4.30 to retain the tuition waiver each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical laboratory research residency; daily participation in laboratory activities and research seminars.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester evaluations conducted by academic advisor and submitted to Graduate School.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is restricted under Korean immigration law; part-time work requires permission from immigration and university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for Korean D-10 job seeker visas or E-7 professional engineering visas upon completion.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Tuition waiver is cancelled if semester GPA drops below 3.50 or if student voluntarily withdraws without completing requirements.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major change requires approval from current advisor, new advisor, and Graduate School dean.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions beyond standard 4 semesters for Master's or 8 semesters for PhD are generally not funded by tuition waiver.
